title: A Birthday for the Mountains
description: The village bakes little mesas for the mountains’ birthday. As the last sugar peak goes on the table, the real mesa sends up candles of colored dust.
alt: A child decorates a tray of mesa-shaped cakes beside a parent. In the distance, pink and gold dust rises from a broad desert mesa at dusk.
pairing: An imagined mountain birthday × mesas with candles of desert dust
